## 5. What must be preserved

These are not concessions. Several are the only reason this audit was possible.

**5.1 The two-gate rhythm — G0 before authoring, G1 before commit (`TEMPLATE:100-103`, `:200-201`, `:229`).** G0 fixed Boredom's scope, axes and anchors before 55 agents ran; correcting axes at spec time costs a conversation, correcting them after costs a rebuild. G1 plus "never commit before sign-off" plus mandatory timestamped `.backups/` (`TEMPLATE:189`) is the only structural protection in the process. **Keep verbatim; change only *what* G1 is shown** — a machine-readable gates report, not a diff and a sample.

**5.2 `manifest.planCorrections` (`TEMPLATE:214`, `BOR-SEC` execution).** The single best piece of process behaviour in the corpus. Boredom recorded 7 deviations with issue / files / **evidence commands and outputs** / resolution / residual. Correction #7 caught the plan **contradicting itself** (`BOR-SEC:208` Strand A vs `:261` Strand A/B), resolved toward the more specific rule, **refused to fabricate** three `bridges-to-fcm` edges for `bor-sec-15/17/19`, cited per-source evidence for each refusal, and explicitly declined to edit the plan so the contradiction would stay visible. Make it a required artifact with a fixed schema.

**5.3 The no-fabrication norm with an escalation path.** The `bor-sec-18` agent refused to build a unit under a false attribution when its PDF proved to be a mislabeled duplicate, and escalated. Preserve "refuse and escalate" as an explicitly sanctioned agent outcome, alongside `****** UNVERIFIED:`.

**5.4 The three-value provenance discipline (`TEMPLATE:38-42`).** `FE` / `FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR>` / `P·anticipatory-application`, with every bridge claim tagged anticipatory and never presented as the source's own. Corpus-wide usage: 2,761 FE, 1,323 P, 1,196 burke-direct, 85 FAITHFUL keys. It is the most consistently applied idea in the whole index and it is exactly what keeps the user's readings separable from the sources'. **Promote from prose convention to a required, closed, validated field.**

**5.5 The 8-tier support taxonomy (`DISS-PIPE:333-341`).** T1-textually-confirmed → T7-overreach → T8-secondary-needed, each with a remediation action. Exercised at scale on 982 records (T3 477, T1 277, T2 78, T5 71, T4 41, T7 22, T6 12, T8 4). This is the field that delivers "every weakness" as a **queryable property** rather than a narrative aside. Adopt verbatim.

**5.6 The interpretive-flag pair (`DISS-PIPE` schema).** `interpretive_flag_present` (boolean) **plus** `interpretive_flag_text` carrying the actual hedge from the prose ("'which I designate as occupying A₃'"). Quoting the hedge is what makes a tier assignment auditable rather than asserted.

**5.7 The claim record schema and its literal JSONC example (`DISS-PIPE:490-535`).** The only place any plan in this repo writes out a record schema — and the only place a working claim layer resulted. That correlation is not an accident.

**5.8 The granularity rule with a worked decomposition + the anti-inflation cap (`DISS-PIPE`).** "One proposition = one claim, not one sentence = one claim", plus a per-section hard cap of 350. Both halves are needed.

**5.9 Anchor discipline — bridge, never re-digest (`TEMPLATE:30-36`).** Pointers to an anchor's unit ids rather than re-explaining its argument. Where the plan enumerated the target ids (`BOR-SEC:24`), resolution was **68/68**. This is what stops ~265 single-source entries becoming ~265 re-explanations of the same books.

**5.10 The de-duplication and haystack rubric (`TEMPLATE:57-67`).** md5-identical DROP; preprint/published MERGE with a `dup-variant` note; >300pp proceedings HAYSTACK with grep-locate and `-f/-l` re-extraction. Concrete, mechanical, and it worked: 49 files → 44 units, with two real salvages from a 727-page volume. Its dispositions persisted into `manifest.excluded` with md5 evidence.

**5.11 Pre-extraction to text, agents given the `.txt` path and never the PDF (`TEMPLATE:137-140`).** Correct for cost and for the known multi-page-image API-400 failure. Only the *destination* is wrong.

**5.12 The OCR-LOW check (`TEMPLATE:141`, `VR-PED:167-170`).** It correctly caught Lombard & Ditton at 0 words; `manifest.ocrAudit` records the range (4,281–21,903 words) and the reasoning for the lowest non-zero count.

**5.13 Hard per-unit numeric floors (`TEMPLATE:162-165`).** 0 violations across 55 units and 34 units. **The mechanism is perfect; only the quantity is wrong.** Keep per-unit hard floors and point them at claims and coverage.

**5.14 The "Not treated:" requirement (`TEMPLATE:158`).** Negative evidence, rare in the corpus, and directly serving "every weakness." Promote from a prose line to a typed absence record.

**5.15 The fixed section skeleton (`TEMPLATE:156-158`, `BOR-SEC:200-202`).** It made 55 independently-built analyses structurally comparable — which is the only reason their ~6,300 propositions are minable at all. Keep the outline; **author it as a rendering of records**.

**5.16 The reliability lesson and post-batch sweep (`TEMPLATE:208-210`).** The ~1/8 subagent no-op is real and documented. Keep the sweep; upgrade what it checks from existence to conformance, and delete "self-author any gaps."

**5.17 Exemplar-driven authoring (`TEMPLATE:213`, `BOR-SEC:178`).** Pointing each agent at a named quality bar works. The exemplar must itself be schema-valid and reachable.

**5.18 The double-locus rule (`WENDT:129`).** `(p.NN / pdf NN)` on every citation — **307/307 = 100% compliance**, the only perfect gate in the family. Precisely specified format + regex-checkable + per-record is the recipe. Extend to a triple locus.

**5.19 `BEX-ANCHOR:38-89` — the corrective-pass template.** Regenerate the live list rather than trusting the cache; precision guard for the double-edge unit; non-destruction check that no unit is orphaned; edit the per-unit source of truth then regenerate the aggregate; fix the tally including a confirmed miscount; verify the delta by **reading** the compiled output. It verifiably worked and is the best-specified operation in all the plans. Port wholesale.

**5.20 `BEX-v2:97-148` — data-fact locking.** Every cell of a 24-cell inventory enumerated with explicit exception flags (`ALT-FORMAT`, `CROP2`, `UNCROPPED`, `TYPO`), a closing accounting line ("21 clean + 3 exceptions … No silent gaps"), and a schema whose verification locus is named **to the line**. Make it a required artifact, not plan prose.

**5.21 `BEX-v2:311-313` — the runtime-derived anonymisation constraint.** S-codes derived in memory from sorted directory order, never persisted, not even as a hardcoded table in the script. `scripts/boredom-o9/common.py` implements it and processed all 8 subjects with zero leakage — **proof that full processing and PII discipline are compatible**, and that `BEX-ANCHOR:101-105`'s escalation to "do not even list the directory" was unnecessary and harmful.

**5.22 `BEX-v2:7` — the worked proof-of-pipeline.** Prove extraction end-to-end on one unit with independent cross-channel corroboration before scaling.

**5.23 The `EVAL:89-95` process firewall.** Draft fully in one condition before opening the other index. Enforceable by tool-call auditing.

**5.24 `EVAL:198-200` (H6).** "Prose hierarchy on top, atomic provenance underneath, with programmatic verifiability of every assertion." That is the target architecture, written down and never built.

**5.25 Analyst self-critique inside artifacts.** Boredom's `emptyColumnNote` diagnosing a category error inherited from the plan's own measure axis and recommending its removal; its `centralFinding` two-route verification; `citation-network.json`'s `methodologicalCaveat`; RDR2's "Gates NOT fully met (reported honestly)"; `debate-map.json`'s `constructedByCluster: 3`. **This candour is why the audit was possible.** Make it a named required field rather than a happy accident.

**5.26 `USAGE:275-282` — the anti-hallucination flag stack** (`--whitelist`, `--citation-max-hallucinations 0`, `--citation-enforcement-mode strict`) as the fixed configuration for every harness arm.

**5.27 Corpus-FIRST retrieval policy (`MIGRATION:89`, `COMPARE:28`).** The authored ontology always runs and seeds query expansion; vectors are additive, never a substitute. Keep the policy; change only the granularity of what it returns.

**5.28 Import from per-entry SOURCE files, never from `compiled-index.json` (`MIGRATION:14-17`).** The lossiness is documented and re-verified.

**5.29 The frozen prompt-suite pattern** (`ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json`: "FROZEN — must not be modified without incrementing version and recording new SHA") and the immutable `_run-history/<ts>/` + `_living/latest.md` pattern in `corpus/index/Dissertation/`.

**5.30 `TEMPLATE:8` — the executor discipline itself:** "every judgment call this plan cannot pre-make is turned into a derivation procedure with a rubric." The instinct is exactly right. It simply was never applied to the record schemas — which is where every defect landed.

## 6. The claim and clause schema — proposed

### 6.1 Design principles

1. **The CLAIM is the atom.** A source is a container of claims. Prose is a *rendering* of records, never an input constraint.
2. **The CLAUSE is a separate, independently-identified record.** One clause may ground many claims; one claim may span several clauses. Nesting the span inside the claim (as every current entry does) makes reuse impossible.
3. **Address and text are separable.** The address is always stored; the text's *storage* is universal and its *display* is rights-tiered. This is what dissolves the copyright/granularity conflict at `TEMPLATE:44-45`.
4. **Ids are the only join key.** Display strings never join.
5. **Every enum is closed, inline in the plan, and validated.** Free text lives in a sibling `*_note` field.

### 6.4 Controlled vocabularies — derived by union-and-dedup from actual use

**`provenance`** — complete observed corpus-wide vocabulary with counts:
`FE` 2,761 · `P/anticipatory-application` 1,323 · `burke-direct` 1,196 · `anticipatory-application` 524 · `INTERP-high` 380 · `INTERP-low` 368 · `calleja-direct` 180 · `FAITHFUL-<author>` 85 distinct keys (Slaby 175, Makransky 154, Parong 144, Richardson 132, Keane 130, Yakobi 108, Nacke 102, Tam 102, Seo 98, Kim 94, Holmqvist 88, Mansikka 86, …) · bracketed variants `[INTERP-high]` 276, `[INTERP-low]` 207, `[FE]` 43, `[P]` 33, `[INTERP-med]` 29, `[INTERP-medium]` 21, `[FE-STUDENT]` 12, `[FE-U]` 10.
**Normalisations required:** merge `INTERP-med` ≡ `INTERP-medium`; merge bare `anticipatory-application` into `P/anticipatory-application`; strip brackets; **resolve `FAITHFUL-<author>` against a per-entry interlocutor registry** — the free-surname convention has already produced `FAITHFUL-B`, `FAITHFUL-C`, `FAITHFUL-DB`, `FAITHFUL-O`, `FAITHFUL-De`, `FAITHFUL-Tu`, and doubled forms (`FAITHFUL-Slaby` 175 vs `FAITHFUL-Slaby & Thonhauser` 8).
**Closed set:** `FE | FE-U | FE-STUDENT | FE-TEACHER | FAITHFUL:<author_key> | P/anticipatory-application | INTERP-low | INTERP-med | INTERP-high | burke-direct | calleja-direct`.

**`support_tier`** — adopted verbatim from `DISS-PIPE:333-341`, the only closed fully-populated tier vocabulary in the corpus. Observed distribution over 982 records: `T3-interpretive-but-flagged` 477 · `T1-textually-confirmed` 277 · `T2-textually-supported` 78 · `T5-under-supported` 71 · `T4-interpretive-but-unflagged` 41 · `T7-overreach` 22 · `T6-unsupported` 12 · `T8-secondary-needed` 4.
**Migration crosswalk:** Uexküll `Strong` → T1/T2, `Moderate` → T3/T5, `Weak` → T6; BCAP "Explicitly stated"/"Textually explicit" → T1, `[INTERP-high] Heidegger's interpretive construction` → T3; VDS tier 1 → T1, tier 2 → T3.

**`stance`** — union-and-dedup of Boredom's 170 free values and VR Pedagogy's, keeping every token that recurs:
`asserts | defines | classifies | reports | extends | refines | qualifies | concedes | contests | refutes | restates | synthesizes | concludes | self-critiques | defers`.
**Critical bug to design out:** Boredom has `stance: "FE"` **22 times**. `stance` and `provenance` must be separate required fields with **disjoint** enums, and the validator must reject cross-contamination. `null` illegal.

**`evidence_type`** — collapsed from Uexküll's 105 distinct values:
`textual-explicit | textual-inferred | philosophical-argument | empirical-experiment | empirical-observation | comparative | analogical | diagrammatic | statistical | anecdotal | authority-citation | methodological-principle`.

**`relation`** — a versioned global registry file, seeded from the 645 observed values, with a reserved core set that may not be renamed and an `other` escape requiring `relation_raw` + a review flag. Entries may extend only by adding a subtype that declares its parent, written back to the registry **in the same commit**.

### 6.5 The locator model, and graceful degradation

A locator is a typed object, not a string. `locator_kind` is one of:

| kind | fields | precision | proven by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `char-span` | `text_layer_id, char_start, char_end` | **clause** | NET-NEW; the sandbox achieves 93.0% (4,615/4,961) |
| `bbox` | `doc_id, page_pdf, x0,y0,x1,y1` | **clause** | `archon evidence find --mode exact` already returns it |
| `bekker` | `work, book, chapter, bekker_start, bekker_end` | **clause** | Aristotle: 2,323 loci **with line numbers**, 3,064 distinct line-anchored strings — an existing clause-level address system |
| `timestamp` | `media_id, start_ms, end_ms, frame_id` | **sub-clause** | RDR2 Playthrough: 529 timestamps + 1,040 frame ids |
| `line-range` | `text_layer_id, line_start, line_end` | near-clause | In-Game 995; Dissertation 982/982 |
| `heidegger-h` | `h_page` | paragraph | `H.96`, `H.95–101` in BT prose |
| `section` | `section_ref` | paragraph | `§21`, `§9b-β` |
| `cell` | `subject, condition, item` | record | VLE / Boredom Experiment: 8 × 3 × 7 |
| `page` | `page_printed, page_pdf` | **coarsest permitted** | `WENDT:129`, 307/307 |

**Degradation rule.** Every claim carries **at least one** locator. `char-span` is **required** wherever the source has an extractable text layer. Degradation to a coarser kind requires an explicit `degradation_reason` from a closed enum (`ocr-only | scanned-image | no-text-layer | rights-withheld-span | media-source`), and the entry's gate report must publish the **span-coverage rate** with a floor of 0.90. A `page`-only locator without a `degradation_reason` is a validation failure. Every locator resolves through the source's declared `page_offset_map`, and ≥5 sampled loci per source must round-trip by exact string match.

### 6.6 Worked example

## 7. Requirements for the new entry-creation plan

Numbered, exhaustive, grouped. Every requirement names its motivating evidence. **This section is the direct input to writing the plan.**

### A. Source preparation

**A1.** Derive the source inventory **from disk** in Phase 0 — `md5sum`, `pdfinfo`, first-page title/author/year/venue extraction — and **diff it against any plan-supplied table**, reporting phantoms and extras as blocking findings before any unit is assigned. *Evidence: `BOR-SEC:44-85` produced a nonexistent "Standish 2015" (a mislabeled Mertel duplicate) costing a build-abort cycle, a reversed byline, and two omitted Elpidorou 2018 files that were the sole grounding for the plan's own debate axis.*

**A2.** Every factual assertion the plan makes about a file (page count, identity, uniqueness, authorship, year) carries its **verification command and output inline**, or is marked UNVERIFIED and assigned to Phase 0. *Evidence: `BOR-SEC:92` asserted a 727-page proceedings volume was "the single extracted paper."*

**A3.** Preserve the de-dup/haystack rubric verbatim (`TEMPLATE:57-67`) and persist every disposition with its md5 into the manifest. *Evidence: 49 files → 44 units with two real salvages; 23 duplicate groups across 288 corpus PDFs.*

**A4.** Add a **source-admissibility precondition**: text-layer sanity (distinct per-page text hashes, extracted-words-per-page floor), ligature integrity probe for the pypdfium2 fi/ff/fl dropout, diacritic probe for the source's language, and citation completeness (author, venue, year, pagination anchor). Record `text_quality`; **quarantine** failures with a remediation task rather than authoring around them. *Evidence: `ptf-01` shipped with identical `text_hash` on all 11 pages and all verbatims UNVERIFIED; `riv-02` shipped with an unverified venue; `ig-10-deep.json:425-430` documents hand-repairing `difﬁ culty`/`sufﬁ cient`/`ﬁ gurative`.*

**A5.** Declare `RIGHTS_TIER` **per source** (`own-work | public-domain | licensed | third-party-copyright`) in the source manifest record. *Evidence: `TEMPLATE:44` hardcodes one assumption for a template meant to process "ANY folder"; the corpus spans the user's own thesis, Aristotle, Equiano 1789, Radcliffe 1794 and in-copyright monographs.*

**A6.** Declare an **ENTRY PROFILE** before building, from a fixed set with different floors and required artifacts: `PRIMARY-DATASET` · `MONOGRAPH` · `ARTICLE-CLUSTER` · `SMALL-PAIR (N≤3)` · `OWN-PROSE`. Record it in the manifest; select gate thresholds from it. *Evidence: a 2-source rhetoric pair, a 4-source theory cluster and a 92 GB instrumented dataset all converged on the same 7–10-node ontology-only shape.*

**A7.** Reserve the entry's id **prefix** in a committed registry (prefix → entry → grammar → allocated ranges → status) as step 0. *Evidence: the `bor-` → `bex-` rename was unrecorded and `bor-` was subsequently taken by Boredom Secondary.*

### B. Extraction and addressing

**B1.** **Commit the normalized full text as an immutable entry artifact**: `<entry>/_source/<source_id>.txt` plus a sidecar `{extractor, extractor_version, exact_command, flags, source_sha256, text_sha256, extracted_at, page_offset_map}`. **Forbid scratchpad destinations.** *Evidence: `TEMPLATE:137-140`, `VR-PED:166-171` (which observes the scratchpad does not persist and specifies it anyway); ~1,000 In-Game clause pointers dead.*

**B2.** Every locator names its `text_layer_id`. **Gate:** every referenced text artifact exists and its `sha256` matches. *Evidence: one deterministic re-extraction under this rule resurrects ~1,000 In-Game clause pointers in a single step.*

**B3.** **Mandatory locator calibration per source before extraction:** sample ≥5 (recommended ≥10) pages spread across the document, record `(page_pdf, page_printed)` pairs, assert the mapping is affine and constant, check monotonicity, and record a **piecewise map** when it is not. Store in the source record. *Evidence: Aristotle 33/34 records wrong by up to 47 pages and 101/188 Bekker loci off by >2; `rickert-structured/manifest.json:7` declares 20 and drifts to 15. Model the good pattern: `Uncomfortable .../us-literary-loci-concordance.json` `page_offset_rule`.*

**B4.** **Gate:** every recorded locus resolves through the declared map into the document's real page/char range, and ≥3 randomly sampled loci per source are verified by **exact string match** on the mapped page.

**B5.** Record `char_start`/`char_end` on **every** clause in a source with an extractable text layer. Degradation to a coarser locator requires a `degradation_reason` from a closed enum. **Gate:** span-coverage rate ≥ 0.90. *Evidence: the sandbox already achieves 93.0% (4,615/4,961); the whole built corpus achieves 0%.*

**B6.** **Persist retrieval provenance, never assert it.** Every quotation record stores `{doc_id, chunk_id, page, bbox[4], char_span, sim, mode, snapshot_id, run_timestamp}` exactly as `archon evidence find --mode exact` returns them. **Ban the token `bbox ✓` as evidence.** *Evidence: 45+ ticks, zero coordinates — a discarded address system.*

**B7.** Apply **UTF-8 NFC normalisation**, one canonical orthography per lemma with `variants[]`, and a checker flagging any two lemmas differing only by normalisation or mojibake. **Forbid encoding fallbacks in the loader** — a decode failure is a hard error. *Evidence: `compile-corpus-index.py:157-163` silently falls back to latin-1; Uexküll ships four orthographies and `Wohnhulle` is the one that compiles.*

**B8.** Treat **Bekker line pairs and media timestamps as first-class clause-address subtypes** with typed slots and resolvers, not prose. *Evidence: Aristotle already records 2,323 Bekker loci with line numbers; RDR2 Playthrough already records 529 timestamps and 1,040 frame ids — both already at or below clause level.*

### C. Schema and IDs

**C1.** **Ship machine-checkable JSON Schema files as artifacts of the plan**, referenced by path: `claim.schema.json`, `clause.schema.json`, `edge.schema.json`, `locus.schema.json`, `tension.schema.json`, `term.schema.json`. Plus **one fully-worked exemplar record per type**. *Evidence: "schema" appears 0× in `TEMPLATE` and 0× in `BOR-SEC`; no `*.schema.json` exists in the repo (verified); 49 schema-violation defects.*

**C2.** **The CLAIM is the unit of production** (§6.3); the unit `.md` is demoted to an optional rendering **generated** from records. *Evidence: `TEMPLATE:152-165` makes the source the atom; 7 records/source vs 50–500 target.*

**C3.** **The CLAUSE is a separate record** (§6.2) referenced by `clause_id`, not nested inside claims.

**C4.** **Forbid bare strings in any array.** *Evidence: 87 bare-string `concepts[]`, 146 bare `interlocutors[]`, 57 bare `sections[]`, 46 bare `tensions[]`.*

**C5.** Fix the case convention (**snake_case**) in the schema, not in prose. *Evidence: `sampleN`/`keyResult` ×45 vs `sample_n`/`key_result` ×38 inside one field set.*

**C6.** **Full id grammar at every level, with worked examples**, globally unique across the whole `corpus/index` tree: `<ENTRY>-<UNIT>-C<nnnn>` claims, `-S<nnn>` sections, `-T<nnn>` tensions, `-Q<nnn>` quotes, `<DOC>-CL<nnnnn>` clauses, `<UNIT>-e<nnn>` edges. **Explicitly forbid unprefixed local counters.** *Evidence: 37 colliding `C1..C22`/`F1..F8`; Wendt 20 collisions; two disjoint registries in one Uncomfortable directory.*

**C7.** Ids are **content-addressed and stable across rebuilds** (`entry + unit + sha256(claim_text)[0:8]`), never positional. *Evidence: `MIGRATION:64`'s `{unit}-c{n}` renumbers on every insert — the mechanism behind 44 dangling-reference and 10 id-collision defects.*

**C8.** **Ids are the only join key.** Name collisions across entries become an explicit authored `sameAs` edge, never an automatic merge. **Gate:** id uniqueness within the entry and a cross-entry collision report. *Evidence: the compiler merges by `name.lower()` (`:1310-1349`), producing 20 fused rows with concatenated provenance and no ids at all.*

**C9.** Every node and record carries a **stable machine id distinct from its display label**; all cross-file references use the id. If a target parser format cannot hold an id, **extend the parser in the same plan and show the diff**. *Evidence: 68 Boredom nodes with no id; 508 back-references keyed on strings that already disagree ("EEG eyes-open vs eyes-closed" vs "…versus eyes-closed baseline").*

**C10.** **Every typed field gets a closed enum stated inline in the plan** (§6.4), with `null` illegal on `stance`, `support_tier` and `provenance`. Any out-of-vocabulary value goes to a per-entry vocabulary-extension file with a one-line justification — **never inlined**. *Evidence: 162 stance values / 195 nulls / 108 hapax.*

**C11.** **Separate every enum from its prose.** `stance` and `provenance` are disjoint enums and the validator rejects cross-contamination; `strength` and `strength_rationale` are separate fields. *Evidence: `stance: "FE"` ×22; `"Strong — multiple independent examples"` producing ~100 values from a 3-value vocabulary; `"Textually explicit (pp. 33, 40, 43)"`.*

**C12.** Preserve the source's own wording as a first-class field (`surface_form`) alongside the normalized label. *Evidence: `TEMPLATE:81-88` normalizes to ≤15 labels and pushes the source's term into an unschematised note.*

**C13.** **Stamp `schema_version` into every artifact.** *Evidence: only Dissertation does; nothing else can be safely migrated.*

**C14.** **Cap every free-text field at a character limit** (~1,200) in the schema, and fail any record whose prose field contains more than one page anchor. *Evidence: `us-03-radcliffe.json:102` carries an 8,000-word `outline` blob; page anchors buried in prose are unaddressable.*

**C15.** **Ship a global, versioned relation-and-type registry** as a plan artifact. Entries extend it only by adding a registered subtype declaring its parent, written back in the same commit. **Gate:** every relation string resolves. *Evidence: 645 relation values, 47 CSV dialects; no cross-entry union possible.*

**C16.** **One concept registry per entry.** **Gate:** id-space disjointness. *Evidence: Uncomfortable's `C-US-01..40` vs `US-C-001..036` with zero overlap.*

**C17.** **One source of truth per fact.** Author the machine-readable form as canonical and **generate** every `.md` rendering by committed script; gate on byte-reproducibility. **Never mandate two hand-authored twins.** *Evidence: `TEMPLATE:114,:176-177`; 36 canonical positions lost to `.json` twins the compiler never opens.*

**C18.** Decouple **storage handles from bibliographic facts**: folders and filenames use the opaque id alone; author/year/title live in the manifest as data. *Evidence: `ped-sec-14`'s folder is permanently `Colin et al. …` while its 30 provenance tags read `FAITHFUL-Barrett et al.`*

**C19.** **Forbid parenthetical qualifiers in any identifier reaching an addressable slot.** State the heading grammar as a testable production: `#### <int>. <Name>` where `Name` matches `^[^()]+$`; qualifiers move to an explicit bullet; aliases are declared, never derived. *Evidence: `VR-PED:118-127` + `:186-187` + `compile-corpus-index.py:687,:734-736` = 19 corrupted nodes and `technological`/`control` corpus-wide.*

**C20.** **Canonical-term admission gate:** a term enters the global greedy-match list only if declared in a per-entry terms file, above a minimum length, and not a bare common English word (stoplist). Print the **full diff** of terms this entry adds, for sign-off. *Evidence: 1,722 entries including whole sentences ("Debate axis 9: social presence reliably predicts…") and the bare words `technological`, `Presence`, `control`.*

**D1.** **Promote the three-tag provenance vocabulary to a required, closed, validated field** (§6.4), normalising `INTERP-med`≡`INTERP-medium`, bare `anticipatory-application`, and bracket variants, with `FAITHFUL:<author_key>` resolving against a per-entry interlocutor registry. *Evidence: 85 free-surname keys including `FAITHFUL-B`, `FAITHFUL-DB`, and doubled forms.*

**D3.** **Make quotation machine-verified, not length-limited.** Store `{quote_id, source_doc, char_start, char_end, exact_text, sha256}`; interpolate quotes into prose **only by quote_id** (wire the existing `scripts/substitute-quote-ids.py`); gate byte equality against the committed source on every build. *Evidence: the `ped-sec-29` fabrication — 6 words, inside the 12-word allowance, tagged FE, undetectable by all fourteen gates.*

**D4.** **Ban quotation marks in hand-typed prose.**

**D5.** **Forbid the `FE` tag on any sentence containing a quoted span lacking a verified `quote_id`.**

**D6.** **Replace the blanket 25-word ban with a rights-tiered storage/display split** (A5): store the exact span for **every** tier as internal evidence with `redact_on_render`; apply word ceilings only to **rendered** output and only for restricted tiers. State the policy explicitly: **a claim/clause index requires the clause**, so the suppression practised at `ig-10-deep.json:434-441` and `us-03-radcliffe.json:110,:234` is incompatible with the goal. *Evidence: zero spans in 1,758 files; definitions truncated to exactly 24 words to clear a ceiling.*

**D7.** **Mandatory bibliographic verification in Phase 1** against the title page and DOI/copyright line, recording the **version-of-record** year. **Gate:** every unit has `verified_bibliography: true`. *Evidence: `ped-sec-14` surname; three unresolved year errors and one mis-linkage in `citation-corrections-2026-07-16.md`, unapplied per its line 52.*

**D8.** **Gate:** no unresolved corrections file and no unresolved verification marker may exist at ship time. *Evidence: 6 of 55 Boredom manifest records carry `year: null`; `bor-sec-11` still carries "(author verification needed)"; a deferred folder rename was never executed.*

**D9.** **Require a `derivation` field on every record** (`agent-read | self-authored | inferred | script-derived`) and **gate on the self-authored fraction**. Record per-unit build provenance (agent id, model, retries, plan sha). *Evidence: `TEMPLATE:208-210`; no record survives of which units were orchestrator-invented.*

**D10.** **Require an independent second-reader verification pass** on a stated sample fraction with a stated pass threshold, performed by a different agent than the author. *Evidence: producer and judge are currently the same agent for every gate.*

**D11.** **Never name a checker the plan does not ship** (§H). *Evidence: `TEMPLATE:198,:228`, `VR-PED:204,:223`, `BEX-ANCHOR:182` all name a verbatim detector that does not exist.*

**D12.** **Cite compiler behaviour by function name plus a reproduction command**, never by line number, and require the executing agent to run it and paste the output. *Evidence: `BEX-ANCHOR` cites "verified `compile-corpus-index.py` L1197–1207" — wrong branch, fallback direction stated backwards.*

(2) Transcript hygiene via a **committed name-blind enumerator** emitting only codes, hashes and counts. **Explicitly forbid any gate that blocks verification of the artifact itself.** *Evidence: `BEX-ANCHOR:101-105` forbade the inspection that would have caught the fabricated `ch-obs` fact; `scripts/boredom-o9/common.py` proves full processing and PII discipline are compatible.*

### E. Edges and connection

**E1.** **One canonical edge record, one physical format** at per-source and aggregate level: `{edge_id, entry_id, subject_id, relation (registry-resolved), object_id, locator[] (a SET), provenance, support_tier, deriving_unit, note}`. Provide the header line **verbatim** in the plan; gate on exact header equality after BOM/CRLF normalisation. *Evidence: four sibling clusters shipped four headers; 47 dialects corpus-wide.*

**E2.** `subject_id`/`object_id` must be **resolvable ids from declared namespaces**. **Gate:** referential integrity — any unresolvable endpoint fails the build. *Evidence: 119 rows with `§4`/`n.8`/`Intro` as subject; `grounds-measure` 0/37 resolved.*

**E3.** **For every cross-entry relation, carry the literal target id list inline in the plan** (as `BOR-SEC:24` does), or a command that generates it. **E5.** **Never dedupe on content.** The global store is a concatenation keyed on `edge_id`; near-duplicate detection produces a **report** a human resolves. **Gate:** `count(global) == Σ count(per-unit)` as exact equality. *Evidence: Boredom lost 18 locus-distinct rows, VR-Ped lost 2 note-distinct rows, from the same instruction.*

**E6.** If any merge occurs, it **unions locator sets** and emits a reconciliation record `{inputs_n, outputs_n, dropped_n, drop_reason_histogram, dropped_ids[]}`. **Gate:** `dropped_n == Σ histogram`, and any `drop_reason: unknown` fails the build. Report `loci_preserved` vs `loci_in`.

**E7.** **Floor the source-derived records and CAP the interpretive ones** (`P`-tagged ≤ 0.15 × (FE + FAITHFUL)). *Evidence: `VR-PED:184,:220` mandate a **minimum** of our own speculation per unit; 117 P-tagged edges = 10.4% of the store.*

**E8.** **Separate the data cap from the render cap, explicitly.** No cap on cross-entry edges, canonical nodes, concordance cells or claim records in the store; caps apply only to a generated view, produced by filtering on tier/centrality. *Evidence: `TEMPLATE:182-185`'s ≤25 cap forced strand-level aggregation that reduced 117 unit-level bridges to integer labels.*

**E9.** **The concordance (and every matrix) is a GENERATED VIEW over claim records**, never authored, never join-built. Every cell-source assertion resolves to exactly one `claim_id` and carries page/span, direction, effect size or null, and provenance. **Gate:** `unbacked_assertions == 0`. **Explicitly forbid mechanical co-occurrence derivation by name.** *Evidence: 316 of 348 assertions (90.8%) unbacked; 0/91 and 0/94 cells carry the mandated locus and note.*

**E10.** **Build a reverse-reference index at compile time** (record id → every file citing it) and make correction **transactional**: changing a record lists all dependents and fails until each is updated or waived. *Evidence: a superseded VLE figure left 12 stale live copies in a sibling entry plus 4 `global-edges.csv` rows.*

**E11.** **The bridge selector must reject empty endpoints before scoring, and omit the block entirely when nothing scores.** Never label an `INTERP-` tagged record "verified". *Evidence: `cross-author-utils.ts:473-474` makes `t.includes('')` always true; 4 of 6 simulated topics render `<-> ? ()` under a MUST-cite directive; 525 of 552 candidates wasted, 85% "unrelated"; well-formed anchors returned 25 of 27 usable — a **6× yield difference**.*

**E12.** **Gate anchor validity to 1.00 before any derivative generation**, and report anchor **coverage** (only 8 of 72 hooks were ever exercised).

**F1.** **Tension is a first-class record with a stated schema** covering all eight shapes on disk: `{tension_id, entry_id, endpoint_a{node_id,label}, endpoint_b{node_id,label}, relation, directed, evidence_locus_a, evidence_locus_b, description, unit_ids[], claim_ids[]}`. **F3.** **Make negative claims a first-class record type** (`claim_kind: negative`) with a locus scope, replacing the prose "Not treated:" line. *Evidence: `bor-sec-30` names 8 explicitly-absent measures and `bor-sec-13` 3 absent constructs — in prose, in no JSON.*

**F4.** **Replace count targets on relational discoveries with coverage + evidence gates.** Every recorded disagreement must cite ≥2 distinct records with resolvable loci on opposing sides, and carry a boolean `staged_by_sources`. ### G. Gates

**G1.** **Every gate is a named executable with a numeric threshold and an exit code**, collected in a committed per-entry gate script. Named checkers the plan must ship **before authoring begins**: `check-schema.py`, `check-ids.py`, `check-loci.py`, `check-projection.py`, `check-density.py`, `check-coverage.py`, `check-registration.py`, `check-quotes.py`, `check-lemmas.py`, `check-mermaid.sh`, `check-debates.py`, `check-reachability.py`, `emit-gates.py`. **A gate whose executable is missing FAILS; it does not pass by narration.**

**G2.** **Mandatory `_synthesis/gates.json` + `metrics.json` per entry**, written by the checker and **never by an authoring agent**: `{gate_id, scope, statement, threshold_expr, threshold_value, measured, verdict (PASS|FAIL|SKIPPED-N1|N/A-by-construction), checker, checker_version, measured_at, input_sha256, evidence_path}` plus an aggregate exit code. The finding SURVIVES refutation. I ran every prescribed failure mode and none of them lands.

(1) Does the plan say what the reporter claims? Yes, verbatim, with a one-line citation slip. TEMPLATE:115 (cited as :116) reads "all per-unit edges concatenated + deduped" and :173 reads "(concat + dedup)". :164 is quoted exactly. Cluster-plan:216 is exact. The one genuinely wrong pointer is "invoked by plan:185", which is blank; the invocation is at :186. These are off-by-ones in a report whose substantive quotations are all verbatim, not misreadings.

(2) Does the plan specify the key elsewhere? No. I grepped both the 238-line template and the 244-line cluster plan for dedup|de-dup|duplicate|id|edge. Every hit is either about md5 source-file dedup at Phase -1.2, about deduping row/column OBJECTS into canonical ontology nodes at 3A, or the two bare "dedup" mentions at :115/:173. Worse than the reporter states: TEMPLATE:162 fixes the edge record schema as exactly `source,relation,target,locus,note`, so the plan defines a record type with NO primary key and then orders a dedup of it. There is no key the executor could have used correctly, because the plan gave the record no identity.

(3) Post-dating? No. Template and cluster plan are both 2026-07-15 with G0 sign-off that day; the build commit d5b648a18 is the plan execution.

(4) Different cause - a later edit? Ruled out empirically. I reconstructed per-unit vs global at all four commits. The same two rows are missing at d5b648a18, before the 2026-07-16 rescope (c92ea3d13) touched anything. And global-minus-per-unit is 0 at every commit, so this is a collapse at synthesis time, not a deletion from one side.

(5) Different cause - an agent deviating from the plan? No. The agent did precisely what :173 told it to do. Dedup was mandated; the key was not; the agent invented one. That is the definition of a plan under-specification defect, and the sibling clusters prove it: RDR2 Secondary and Aristotelian Emotion emitted global == unit exactly (no dedup at all), Boredom Secondary went the other direction with 410 global-only rows and 18 unit rows dropped, Phantasia produced a third dialect entirely. One instruction, four incompatible executions. That is stronger plan-attribution evidence than the reporter supplied.

(6) Does the consequence exist on disk? Yes, exactly as described, and I confirmed the secondary claim about the five surviving triples by enumerating all seven collision groups. The mechanism is also exactly as diagnosed: the two casualties are the only collisions whose loci were both `n/a`, and `n/a` is licensed precisely because :163-164 mandates bridge edges to anchor unit ids while excusing page anchors "where applicable". The plan simultaneously requires the edge type that cannot carry a locus and uses locus as the only available discriminator. The escape clause and the missing key intersect at exactly one point, and that is where both losses landed.

(7) Would the fix work? Partly, and it needs one amendment. Stable per-record ids plus concatenation-by-id would have preserved both rows, and a duplicate REPORT rather than a silent drop is the right control. The exact-equality gate would have caught this instance (1,131 != 1,129 fails). But strict equality is under-specified in the same way the original was: Boredom Secondary carries 410 legitimate-looking global-only rows from units whose per-unit edges.csv do not exist, so the new gate would fail that build too - correctly in that case, but the new plan must say WHERE synthesis-authored edges are allowed to live (a synthesis pseudo-unit with its own id prefix and its own file) or the gate either forbids synthesis-originated edges without saying so or produces unexplainable failures. Also worth carrying into the new plan: the gate as written is a floor of 12*N against an actual 1,129, off by a factor of four from being able to detect any loss, and at N=1 it degrades to ">= 12", which a single deep unit clears alone - the gate is vacuous by construction at every N, not merely at N=1.

Severity correction, HIGH to MEDIUM, on blast radius only. The confirmed loss is 2 records out of 1,131 (0.18%); the source rows survive in the per-unit CSVs so recovery is deterministic; and the compiler never opens any edges.csv, so global-edges.csv reaches no runtime consumer today - the whole 1,129-row file is already unreachable content, which is a separate and larger defect. The reason this finding still matters at MEDIUM rather than LOW is forward-looking and belongs in the new plan verbatim: the casualties are bridge edges, i.e. the cross-pipeline connective tissue the stated goal ("every point of connection") is specifically about; the loss is undetectable by any gate the plan defines; and at claim level the same keyless dedup becomes catastrophic rather than cosmetic. At ~50-500 claim records per source, the differentiating content IS the note/text field, and many claims will legitimately share (source, relation, target, page) - a locus-keyed dedup would then silently merge distinct claims at scale rather than losing two. The rule the new plan must state is that identity is an assigned id, never content, and that no pipeline stage may ever reduce a record count silently.
result.true_cause: The plan is not blameless, but the fault is broader than the reporter framed it. Root cause is that TEMPLATE:162 defines the edge record with no primary key, and TEMPLATE:115/:173 then order a dedup of that keyless record. A merge over a keyless type is undefined by construction, so the executing agent had to invent an identity function; it chose (source, relation, target, locus). TEMPLATE:163-164 independently mandates bridge edges to anchor unit ids while excusing page anchors "where applicable", which licenses locus='n/a' on exactly the edge class that has no other discriminator. The two failures intersect at the only two collision groups whose loci were both 'n/a', and both were dropped. The gate at cluster-plan:216 counts a post-dedup floor (>=276) against an actual 1,129, so it is roughly four times too loose to detect any loss and would remain vacuous at any N. Contributing but not causal: global-edges.csv is read by no consumer in the repo (the compiler reads only *-ontology.md and tension-edges.json), so the loss is invisible to every downstream check as well.

All four secondary examples verified verbatim: VLE `W25`, `global immersion`, `capstone prerequisite`; Boredom Experiment `first-person in-VR headset feed`.

5) CHRONOLOGY? Plan pre-dates the damage. Both plans first committed 2026-07-15 05:47; the VR Pedagogy cluster-ontology.md first committed 2026-07-16 07:03 — one day later. No post-dating defence.

6) THE STRONGEST REFUTATION ATTEMPT — "the author deviated from the exemplar." I checked the named exemplar. FCM book-level-ontology.md:66-82 uses `- **german_lemma**: Grundstimmung` bullets and has ZERO parentheticals in any `#### N.` heading. So literal obedience to "replicate exactly" would not have produced the defect, and one could argue the author deviated. This defence FAILS, for three reasons. (a) You cannot deviate from an unwritten rule — the plan never stated that the heading has a typed second position, never forbade parentheticals, and never named the lemma fields. The exemplar is SILENT on the parenthetical position, and silence in an example is not a prohibition; an author disambiguating Slater's technological immersion from psychological immersion reaches for an English parenthetical because nothing signals the heading is machine-parsed beyond the name. (b) The plan affirmatively asserts "the compiler parses this section" while supplying an incomplete grammar — that is precisely the false-assumption-about-code: it assumes exemplar-mimicry is a sufficient spec for a machine parser. (c) The pattern is corpus-wide, not one rogue agent: parenthetical headings appear in 12 entries (VR Pedagogy 40, Being and Time 34, Grammar of Motives 31, In-Game 19, Uncomfortable 16 ...), and 259 nodes corpus-wide carry non-Greek text in `greek`. Systemic recurrence across independent executing agents is the signature of an under-specified spec, not of individual deviation.

7) THE GATE MEASURES THE WRONG THING — an additional plan defect the reporter understates. TEMPLATE:173-176 and Boredom:239-240 require only "verify the new entry's node/term counts in compiled-index.json (do not assume)" and GATE G1 shows "compiled node/term counts". A COUNT check is structurally incapable of detecting that greek="technological": the node count and term count are both correct. The plan's only compiler-wiring gate cannot see this class of defect at all.

CO-CAUSATION, stated fairly: the compiler's silent coercion at :733-734 is a genuine proximate co-cause — it accepts free text into a typed lemma field with no validation and no warning. The plan is not the sole cause. But the plan is the only specification the executing agent had, and it is the artefact the deliverable can fix.

CORRECTIONS TO THE REPORT (do not refute, but calibrate). (a) Evidence padding: of the eight canonicalTerms cited, only `technological` and `control` originate from the parenthetical→greek path. `action` enters via an alias, `Presence` and `Emotion` via node NAME (an intended path), and `image`/`world`/`time` match none of name/greek/aliases exactly. Six of eight are misattributed to this mechanism. (b) The corpus-wide figure is 259 by my recount, not 242 — and that figure legitimately includes German lemmas, which belong in `greek` by design per :731, so it overstates pollution. (c) The exemplar is described as "a Heidegger/Greek exemplar"; FCM is a GERMAN exemplar using `german_lemma`, and it contains no parentheticals — an imprecision that, if anything, strengthens the mechanism.

PROPOSED FIX ASSESSMENT: mostly sound, one part inadequate. Publishing the field grammar, forbidding parentheticals in node headings, and requiring explicit `greek_lemma`/`german_lemma` (which FCM already does correctly) would each independently prevent this defect. But the proposed gate — "no canonicalTerm may be a lowercase common English word absent from a declared lemma allow-list" — is only partially effective: it catches `technological` and `control`, but misses `W25`, `global immersion`, `capstone prerequisite`, and `first-person in-VR headset feed`, none of which is a lowercase common English word. The gate should instead assert a charset/allow-list constraint on the `greek` FIELD at its source (must match Greek/German lemma charset or appear in a declared allow-list), and the compiler's :733-734 fallback should warn or be removed rather than silently coerce.

WHY THIS MATTERS FOR THE NEW PLAN (deliverable-facing): at N=1 this gate is vacuous — a single article's node/term counts are trivially "verified" and nothing detects a mistyped field. At claim level (~50-500 records per source rather than ~7 nodes), the "replicate exemplar exactly" instruction scales catastrophically: every unstated field position becomes an invention point, and each executing agent invents differently — which is exactly the 9-incompatible-sub-schemas and 24-header-dialects pattern the audit found elsewhere. The transferable rule: for ANY machine-parsed artefact, publish a field grammar with the semantics and value-domain of every position, never delegate the spec to an example, and gate on TYPE conformance not on COUNTS.

# Synthesis: Index Entry-Creation Plans — Adversarial Review

**Scope:** all entry-creation plans under `plans/` that produced any of the 27 entries in `corpus/index/`, judged against the stated goal — *"a large and extraordinarily detailed index of every document. Every claim and every clause. Every point of connection and every weakness."*

**Verification posture:** 207 plan defects filed; 89 of 93 spot-verified survived refutation. The confirmations carried numeric corrections which are used below in preference to the originals. Seven refutations are material and are reported in §2B; refuted causal claims are not reused as evidence anywhere in this document.

---

## 1. What the current authoring process actually is

### 1.1 The plan lineage

Three generations, in causal order:

| Generation | Plans | Entries produced |
|---|---|---|
| **G1 — hand-authored, per-cluster** | `plans/phantasia-cluster-2025-analysis.md` (2026-05-10), `plans/rdr2-secondary-cluster-analysis.md` (2026-06-23), `plans/heidegger-*-analysis.md`, `plans/wendt-design-for-dasein-analysis.md`, `plans/grammar-of-motives-burke-1945-analysis.md` | Phantasia Secondary, RDR2 Secondary, BT, BCAP, FCM, Wendt, Grammar, Uncomfortable, Uexküll, Rickert |
| **G2 — the gold-standard instance** | `plans/boredom-secondary-cluster-index-plan-2026-07-14.md` (287 lines) | Boredom Secondary (Part III) |
| **G3 — the canonical template** | `plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md` (238 lines), which states at `:4-6` it is *"Modeled on"* the Boredom plan and its executed output | Instantiated exactly once, as `plans/vr-pedagogy-secondary-cluster-index-plan-2026-07-15.md` (244 lines) → VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III) |
| **off-lineage** | `plans/boredom-experiment-index-entry-plan-2026-07-10.md` (281 l), `-v2-2026-07-11.md` (313 l), `-channel-schema-anchor-plan-2026-07-16.md` (201 l), `plans/new-media-presence-ingestion-phase1-report-2026-07-20.md` | Boredom Experiment, Presence Theory, Social Presence, Rhetoric of Interactivity |

**Chronology matters and was previously mis-stated.** The template *post-dates* Boredom by ~10 hours and post-dates Phantasia/RDR2/Emotion by 22–65 days. It did not cause those entries' defects; it **codified** Boredom's shape and propagated it forward. Its only true instantiation is VR Pedagogy — which drew 36 defects, the most of any entry in the corpus.

### 1.2 The pipeline as practised (template `§5`, `:136-185`)

**Phase −1 — Survey & self-authored spec** (`:49-102`). `pdfinfo` + `md5sum` + `pdftotext -l 3` per file (`:54`); de-dup/haystack rubric (`:57-67`); derive 4–8 "strands"; derive the concordance axes (≤15 × ≤15) and the ≤12-type controlled vocabulary; emit a filled cluster spec to `plans/`. → **GATE G0**: present spec, wait for human sign-off (`:102`).

**Phase 0 — Extraction + overview** (`:137-146`). `pdftotext` every source **to the scratchpad** `<scratchpad>/<prefix>-txt/` (`:138`), one `.txt` each; agents get the `.txt` path, never the PDF. Write `phase0-overview.md` and `_synthesis/manifest.json` (`:145`), the latter declared authoritative thereafter (`:78-79`).

**Phase 1 — Per-source metadata** (`:148-150`). One agent per unit, batched ~8. Header fields only.

**Phase 2 — Deep per-source** (`:152-165`). One agent per unit; two-pass on `deep-long`. Each unit emits three files:
- `.md` — paraphrastic prose, **budgeted in words**: 1,500–3,500 (humanities) / 1,000–2,500 (empirical) / 400–1,000 (map) (`:153-154`); fixed 9-part skeleton; ends with a `"Not treated:"` line (`:158`).
- `.json` — a bag of parallel arrays: `constructs[], measures[], readings[], concepts[], interlocutors[], tensions[], bridges{}` (`:160`). **No element schema.**
- `-edges.csv` — `source,relation,target,locus,note`; floors map ≥12 / deep ≥20 / deep-long ≥35 (`:162`).

**Phase 3 — Cluster synthesis, authored in the main loop, not by subagents** (`:167-180`). 3A ontology (`#### N. Name` + bullets, `:168-172`); 3B `global-edges.csv` "concat + dedup" + debate map (`:173`); 3C concept-matrix + contested readings; 3D concordance + ≥50-lemma terminology appendix (`:176-178`); 3E citation networks + 5 Mermaid graphs + evolution narrative.

**Phase 4 — Cross-pipeline** (`:182-185`). `bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md`, pointers only; `graph-cross-pipeline-bridge.mmd` capped at ≤25 edges.

**Phase 5 — Compiler wiring, done LAST** (`:187-201`). Back up `compile-corpus-index.py` and `compiled-index.json`; add **one hand-edited dict entry to `TEXT_DIRS`**; run the compiler; "verify node/term counts by reading (do not assume)"; "re-run the repo's verbatim-quote detector" (`:199` — **this tool does not exist**). → **GATE G1**: show TEXT_DIRS diff + compiled counts + one sample unit trio, wait for sign-off; never commit before G1 (`:200-201`).

**Orchestration** (`:205-214`): budget `1 + N + N`; documented ~1-in-8 subagent no-op rate with the mitigation *"verify all three files exist on disk for every unit and **self-author any gaps**"* (`:210`); deviations recorded in `manifest.json → planCorrections` (`:214`).

**Gates** (`:216-229`): eight markdown checkboxes in the plan file. No artifact is emitted. No script exists.

### 1.3 What actually reaches runtime

`scripts/compile-corpus-index.py` opens exactly **two** files per registered entry:
- `<analysis_subdir>/book-level-ontology.md`, else `cluster-ontology.md` — `collect_ontology_nodes` (~`:1185-1229`), warning only when the file is **missing**, never when it parses to zero nodes;
- `<analysis_subdir>/tension-edges.json` — `collect_tension_edges` (~`:1254-1273`), requiring `node_a`/`node_b`.

`collect_cross_pipeline_hooks` globs the Aristotle directory only. Nothing else in `corpus/index/` is read by any runtime consumer. Verified output of the whole corpus:

```

### 3.2 Verdict on the cross-unit-gate argument

The claim that "most gates collapse at N=1" is **overstated, and the overstatement matters** because it would license discarding gates that are salvageable. The correct, evidence-checked position:

**Genuinely GROUP-scope — evaluate to nothing at N=1, no substitute possible:**
1. **Documented debates (G-3)** — verified multi-unit in every instance examined (12/12 Phantasia, 11/11 Boredom, minimum 3 units per axis).
2. **Intra-cluster citation network (G-6)** — worse than collapse: the `max(10, …)` form is *unsatisfiable*, which taught executors to talk past gates (RDR2: "a finding, not a shortfall of the build").
3. **Scholarly-evolution arc** (`TEMPLATE:123, :179-180`) — the date range is a point.

**NOT cross-unit, contrary to the filed claim:**
- **Contested readings (G-4)** survive intact when contestation is against a *named external interlocutor*. They are currently unmeasurable for a different reason: no record format at all (VR Pedagogy: free prose with `**CR-NN.**` run-ins, 18 declared vs 21 regex hits).
- **The concordance (G-7)** survives. Phantasia's is keyed `loci_by_work` — *source × locus*. At N=1 it becomes the single row of locus cells one article fills, which is exactly the addressable payload the goal wants.
- **Concept nodes** survive: 9 of 41 gold-cluster concepts are already single-unit.
- **Edge floors (G-17)** are per-unit by construction; the cluster-level 12·N restatement is redundant.

**Therefore:** move 3 gates to an additive GROUP layer with an explicit `N/A-by-construction` emission below a declared minimum membership (≥5, since the three ratified clusters sit at N=2,3,4). Keep everything else at ENTRY scope and re-express it as a per-source intensive quantity. Skipping a GROUP gate must be a recorded **pass**, not a waiver.

### 3.3 Gates satisfied by agent self-attestation rather than by a check

**All 17 are. Zero gates in the entire lineage are enforced by code.** Ranked by how far self-attestation travels from the truth:

| Gate | How it is "satisfied" | Evidence it was wrong |
|---|---|---|
| **G-9 verbatim ban** | agent asserts | RDR2 report: *"per-unit agents verified (longest ~19 w)"* — self-report; ≥4 fabricated spans shipped in `ped-sec-29` |
| **G-15 verbatim detector** | narration only | the tool does not exist |
| **G-13 compiler clean** | process returned | 55 tension records discarded with 0 warnings |
| **G-10 provenance throughout** | agent asserts | 201 of 463 Boredom readings have a null tag; 195 have a null stance |
| **G-7 concordance complete** | prose strings inside the artifact it judges (`"SATISFIED 55/55"`, `"columnToChannelGate: SATISFIED 12/12"`) | all 12 are placeholders |
| **G-11 graphs render** | asserted or deferred | RDR2 deferred on a false premise (`mmdc` is installed) |
| **G-3/G-4/G-5/G-6 counts** | typed into prose or embedded self-attested `gate{}` objects (Boredom `citation-network.json` carries its own `{required:10, deliveredTotal:65, satisfied:true}`) | VR shipped 18 contested readings against a stated band of 8–12, unflagged |
| **G-1 completeness** | `ls` | `units/` empty in both entries; three units with 0 readings pass |
| **G-14 compiled counts** | human reads two integers | 19 of 60 VR nodes corrupted; count was correct, content was not |
| **G-16 backups/G1** | asserted | Boredom's `.backups/` contains 9 files, none of them the two the plan names |

**Structural fault:** gate objects are embedded *inside the artifacts they judge*, authored by the agent that produced them. There is no separation of producer and judge anywhere in the process.

## 5. What must be preserved

These are not incidental. Several are the only reason this audit was possible.

**P1 — GATE G0 (`TEMPLATE:100-103`).** A cheap, early, human sign-off on scope, axes and vocabulary *before* any expensive authoring. Correcting the vocabulary at spec time costs one turn; correcting it after 55 agents costs the build. **Extend what G0 approves to include the record schema and the density band.**

**P2 — GATE G1 + no-commit-before-G1 + timestamped `.backups/` (`TEMPLATE:189, :200-201, :229`).** The only structurally sound line in §8. **Change *what* G1 is shown** — a machine-readable gates report, not a dict diff and two integers — and **move registration off the end** so an entry is visible-and-empty on day one.

**P3 — `manifest.json → planCorrections` (`TEMPLATE:214`, `boredom:214`).** Genuinely excellent and demonstrably used. Boredom's seven corrections each carry issue / files / **evidence array with the verification command and its output** / resolution / residual. Correction #7 caught the plan **contradicting itself** (`:208` Strand-A vs `:261` Strand-A/B), resolved to the more specific rule, **refused to fabricate three edges**, cited per-source evidence for each refusal, and deliberately declined to edit the plan so the contradiction stayed visible. Nothing else in 27 entries comes close. **Formalise the schema; pair it with gates — it catches what agents notice, gates catch what they do not** (it missed `bor-sec-00` entirely).

**P4 — The no-fabrication norm with an escalation path.** The `bor-sec-18` agent refused to build a unit under a false attribution when its PDF proved to be a mislabeled duplicate, and escalated. **"Refuse and escalate" must remain an explicitly sanctioned agent outcome.**

**P5 — The three-tag provenance discipline (`TEMPLATE:38-42`).** `FE` / `FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR>` / `P·anticipatory-application`. The most consistently applied idea in the corpus (2,761 / 1,323 / 1,196 / 524 occurrences) and the mechanism that keeps the user's readings separable from the sources'. **Keep the concept; close the vocabulary; move it from prose into a required field.**

**P6 — The anchor discipline: bridge, never re-digest (`TEMPLATE:30-36`).** Cite the anchor's own unit ids; find its canonical id list before authoring. This is what stops N single-source entries becoming N re-explanations of the same book. **Strengthen into a resolved-reference requirement.**

**P7 — Enumerating cross-entry target ids literally in the plan (`boredom:24`).** 100% resolution where done, 0% where not. **Do it for every relation, or ship the command that generates the list.**

**P8 — Declaring closed axis vocabularies verbatim in the plan (`boredom:147-157`).** 96% conformance across 55 independent agents, and the reason Boredom has none of the double-registry defect that hit Uncomfortable. **Declare inline, never by reference.**

**P9 — The de-dup / haystack rubric (`TEMPLATE:57-67`).** md5 DROP, same-study MERGE with `dup-variant`, `>300pp` HAYSTACK with grep-locate and `-f/-l` re-extraction, `HAYSTACK-UNRESOLVED` flag, dispositions persisted to `manifest.excluded` with md5 evidence. Concrete, mechanical, executed, and it produced two real salvages.

**P10 — Mandatory pre-extraction with agents given the `.txt` path, never the PDF (`TEMPLATE:137-140`).** Correct for cost and for the known multi-page-image API-400 failure. **Change only the destination:** committed and hashed, not scratch.

**P11 — The OCR-LOW check.** `pdftotext` word-count sanity with a documented fallback; correctly caught two 0-word sources and recorded the audit range in the manifest.

**P12 — The reliability lesson (`TEMPLATE:208-210`).** The documented ~1-in-8 subagent no-op with a mandatory post-batch sweep — the one enforced check in the plan, 100% trio completeness on all three template-lineage clusters. **Keep the sweep; upgrade what it checks from existence to conformance; delete "self-author any gaps".**

**P13 — The agent context bundle (`TEMPLATE:211-213`) and a named quality exemplar.** Right mechanism; the exemplar must itself be a schema-valid, reachable record set.

**P14 — `"Not treated:"` (`TEMPLATE:158`).** Negative evidence, rare and directly serving "every weakness". **Promote from a trailing prose line to a first-class record type.**

## 6. The claim and clause schema — proposed

### 6.0 Design axiom

**Separate the ADDRESS from the TEXT.** Every claim carries a machine-verifiable address into a committed, hashed text projection, *whether or not* the verbatim is stored or displayable. Rights govern **display**, never **storage or verification**. This resolves the copyright/clause-level contradiction that has shaped the entire corpus away from span-level indexing.

### 6.1 The CLAUSE record

The addressable span of source text, independently identified, **referenced by** claims rather than nested inside them (one clause grounds many claims; one claim spans several clauses).

| Field | Type | Justified by |
|---|---|---|
| `clause_id` | `<DOC>-CL<nnnnn>` | net-new; required for many-to-many |
| `doc_id` | sha256(source file) + `edition_key` | In-Game addressed `/tmp`; Aristotle addressed "the PDF" and a superseded offset silently poisoned 33/34 unit records |
| `text_layer_id` | → `{tool, tool_version, exact_command, flags, text_sha256, extracted_at}` | two extractions give different offsets; without this every offset is a guess |
| `char_start` / `char_end` | int into that text layer | **NET-NEW — the single structural addition that moves the corpus from page to clause** |
| `sentence_index` | int | net-new |
| `line_start` / `line_end` | int | already in use and cheaply recoverable: In-Game 858 line refs; Dissertation anchors 982/982 by line |
| `page_pdf` / `page_printed` | int | universal; `page_printed` derived through the offset map |
| `citation_address` | typed union (below) | Aristotle `aristotle-bekker-index.json` `{bekker, description, concepts[], pdf_page, unit_id, work}` — an edition-independent address stored *alongside* a rendering-specific one |
| `quote` | exact text | Dissertation's 235 cached verbatims prove claim+words-linked works |
| `quote_sha256`, `quote_word_count` | | the hash is the address that survives re-extraction; the word count drives the rights gate |
| `normalized_quote` | NFC, ligature-repaired, whitespace-collapsed | Uexkull/Uexküll/Uexkuell in one entry; pdfium drops fi/ff/fl invisibly |
| `rights_tier` | enum: `own-work \| public-domain \| licensed \| third-party-copyright` | one hardcoded assumption at `TEMPLATE:44` suppressed verbatim across public-domain and own-work sources alike |
| `redact_on_render` | bool | derived from `rights_tier` + `quote_word_count`; governs display only |
| `insertion_anchor` | short verbatim phrase of the *target* text | Dissertation: 235/235; the corpus's only content-addressed pointer that **still resolves today**, unlike line ranges |

**`citation_address` variants, each already in use somewhere:**
- `bekker {work, book, chapter, bekker_start, bekker_end}` — Aristotle: 2,323 loci with line numbers, **already a clause-level address system**
- `heidegger_h {h_page}` — BT prose ("H.96", "H.95–101")
- `section {section_ref}` — "§21", "§9b-β"
- `timestamp {ms_start, ms_end, frame_id}` — RDR2 Playthrough: 1,040 frame ids + 529 timestamps, **below clause level on the temporal axis**
- `dataset_cell {subject, condition, item}` — Boredom Experiment / VLE
- `page_range {page_start, page_end}` — the universal fallback

**Graceful degradation ladder** (record `locator_precision` explicitly, and gate on the distribution):

| Precision | Requirement | Reason code when degraded |
|---|---|---|
| `char-span` | source has an extractable text layer | — |
| `line-range` | text layer exists, offsets not computed | `OFFSETS-DEFERRED` |
| `bekker` / `h-page` / `section` | canonical numbering present in source | — (equivalent to clause level; **not** a degradation) |
| `timestamp` | AV source | — |
| `page` | OCR-degraded or image-only source | `OCR-LOW`, `NO-TEXT-LAYER` |
| `none` | forbidden | build fails |

### 6.2 The CLAIM record

| Field | Type | Justified by |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | `<ENTRY>-<UNIT>-C<nnnn>`, globally unique, registered | Dissertation declares `claim_id_format` and achieves 982 with zero collisions; BT 108/108 distinct; BCAP 146; VDS 157. Counter-proof: Wendt 91 id-less, 20 colliding; Boredom 42 values colliding across 8 units |
| `entry_id`, `unit_id` | required | Wendt's per-file `C1` is meaningless without them |
| `claim_text` | ≤60 words, **our paraphrase** | canonical name from Dissertation (422 records); the same field is spelled `tx`, `text`, `claim`, `statement` across 6 entries — pick one |
| `claim_kind` | **closed enum** (§6.3) | Dissertation `claim_type` populated 982/982 → the facet is wanted; it has **378 distinct values** → it must be closed |
| `scope` | **closed enum** | Being and Time `status` — the only place argumentative altitude is recorded, and 101/108 rows controlled |
| `stance` | **closed enum** | Boredom 162–170 free values / 195 nulls / 138 hapaxes. **Critical bug to design out:** `stance: "FE"` occurs 22 times — a provenance tag in the stance field. Disjoint enums, both required, validator rejects cross-contamination |
| `support_tier` | **closed 8-value enum** | Dissertation `support_tier_legend`, exercised on 982 records. **This is the field that delivers "every weakness"** |
| `evidence_type` | **closed enum** | Von Uexküll's `Evidence type` column, 107/107 — the only place in the corpus separating *what kind* of evidence from *how strong* |
| `strength_rationale` | free text, **separate field** | Uexküll glued rationale to enum with an em-dash → ~100 values from a 3-value vocabulary; BCAP glued page numbers in. **Never fuse an enum and its prose** |
| `provenance` | **closed enum** + registry-resolved author slot | `TEMPLATE:38-42`, the most-used idea in the corpus; needs a registry because free surnames produced `FAITHFUL-B`, `FAITHFUL-DB`, `FAITHFUL-O`, and doubled forms |
