## 7. Requirements for the new entry-creation plan

Numbered, grouped, each with the evidence that motivates it. This is the direct input to writing the plan.

### A. Source preparation

**A1.** Derive the source inventory **from disk** in Phase 0 — `md5sum`, `pdfinfo`, first-page text extraction of title/author/year/venue — and diff it against any plan-supplied table, reporting phantoms and extras as **blocking** findings before any unit is assigned. *(`boredom:44-85` produced a phantom paper, a reversed byline, and two omissions that were the sole grounding for the plan's own debate axis; `boredom:92` asserted a 727-page proceedings volume was a single paper.)*

**A2.** Every factual assertion a plan makes about a file (page count, identity, uniqueness, authorship, year) carries its **verification command and output inline**, or is marked UNVERIFIED with the verification assigned to Phase 0. *(same)*

**A3.** Retain the de-dup/haystack rubric verbatim (md5 DROP / same-study MERGE with `dup-variant` / `>300pp` HAYSTACK with grep-locate and `-f/-l` re-extraction / `HAYSTACK-UNRESOLVED`), and persist dispositions with md5 evidence to the manifest. *(`TEMPLATE:57-67`; 23 duplicate groups across 288 corpus PDFs; two real salvages)*

**A4.** **Source admissibility precondition.** Before authoring: distinct per-page text hashes, extracted-words-per-page floor, ligature-integrity probe (pypdfium2 fi/ff/fl dropout), expected-diacritic probe for the source's language, and citation completeness (author, venue, year, pagination anchor). Record `text_quality` per source. Quarantine failures with a remediation task; do not author around them. *(`ptf-01` shipped with an identical hash on all 11 pages and all verbatims UNVERIFIED; `riv-02` with an unverified venue; `ig-10-deep.json:425-430` documents the ligature damage; Uexküll's corrupted orthography is the variant that reaches runtime)*

**A5.** **Rights tiering per source**, recorded in the source manifest: `own-work / public-domain / licensed / third-party-copyright`. *(`TEMPLATE:44` hardcodes one assumption for a template meant to process "ANY folder"; Aristotle, Equiano 1789, Radcliffe 1794, Austen 1811 and the user's own thesis were all suppressed under it)*

**A6.** **Commit the normalized text projection** as an immutable artifact inside the entry: `<entry>/_source/<source_id>.txt` + sidecar `{tool, tool_version, exact_command, flags, source_sha256, text_sha256, extracted_at, page_map[]}`. Every locator names that artifact id. *(`TEMPLATE:138` sends it to a scratchpad; `vr-ped:239` observes the scratchpad does not survive a session and specifies it anyway; ~1,000 In-Game clause pointers are dead as a result)*

**A7.** **Page-offset calibration, mandatory, multi-anchor, drift-tested.** ≥10 verified `(page_printed, page_pdf)` pairs spread across the document; assert monotonicity and affineness; record a piecewise map when it drifts; re-verify whenever `source_sha256` changes. *(Aristotle 33/34 records wrong by ≤47pp, bekker-index 101/188 off by >2; Rickert declared 20, drifts 18→15; the correct pattern already exists at `Uncomfortable Situations/_synthesis/us-literary-loci-concordance.json` `page_offset_rule` and in `Wendt/_synthesis/page-offset-verification.md`)*

**A8.** **Per-source structural inventory as a Phase-1 artifact**: section list with page ranges, table/figure list, page count, word count. This is the denominator that makes coverage computable rather than asserted. *(no coverage gate is currently possible; Holmqvist 53pp yielded 0.19 readings/page vs Aho 3pp at 1.67 — an inverse density relation no count floor can see)*

### B. Extraction and density

**B1.** **The CLAIM is the unit of production; prose is a rendering of it.** State this before any phase. *(the source-as-atom design at `TEMPLATE:127-130` is the granularity ceiling)*

**B2.** **Delete all prose word budgets.** Prose length is an output, not an input constraint. *(`TEMPLATE:153-154`; 17 of 18 band violations are overshoots — the measurable signature of analysts writing into prose what the schema could not hold)*

**B3.** **Density floor expressed per 1,000 source words**, calibrated at **one record per 58–60 source words** (Dissertation 1/58 over 982 records; Veri(dis)similitude 262 addressable rows / 15,481 words = 1/59; the sandbox achieves 155–512 claims per article). Per-source floors: monograph ≥150, article ≥40, MA thesis ≥60. Compute the target from `A8`'s word count and record `claim_count_target` vs `claim_count_actual`. *(current: Boredom 1 per ~1,218 source words, ~21× coarser)*

**B4.** **Coverage floor, not effort floor:** sections-with-≥1-claim / total sections = 1.0; pages-with-≥1-locus / total pages ≥ declared threshold. *(edge floors passed 55/55 while three units shipped zero readings)*

**B5.** **Distribution gate:** no unit below 50% of the entry median claims-per-page. *(one under-extracted source currently hides inside a healthy aggregate)*

**B6.** **Negative claims are records**, not a trailing prose line. *(`TEMPLATE:158` mandates `"Not treated:"`; bor-sec-30 names 8 explicitly-absent measures and bor-sec-13 names 3 absent constructs, none of which appear in any JSON array)*

**B7.** **Windowed authoring protocol** for high-density production: id pre-allocation per window, deterministic window boundaries from `A8`'s section inventory, explicit merge step. *(at 50–500 records × 55 sources a single main-loop pass is 5,000–27,500 records; `TEMPLATE:167` requires main-loop authoring of the aggregate)*

**B8.** **Migration is part of the plan, not a sequel.** Specify a deterministic lift for each existing shape: Dissertation `phase2-claims.json` (982, already schema-shaped) · VDS pipe table (157 rows with tier + disposition + anchor enum) · BT markdown table (108 rows + 299 fenced-JSON edges + 84 claim→tension back-refs) · Uexküll `Claim|Evidence type|Strength|Page ref` (107) · BCAP enumerated premises (150) · FCM (245 + ~1,100 locus-anchored prose claims + 2,090 quoted spans) · Boredom `readings[]` (2,924 sub-items, 2,012 of 2,258 dict-shaped already carrying a page locus) · Wendt `{text, locus}` (139) · Uncomfortable positions + 176 clause-level loci records · Aristotle (973 Bekker bullets, 2,323 loci) · In-Game (995 line anchors, resurrectable by one deterministic re-extraction) · RDR2 Playthrough (1,040 frame ids + 529 timestamps + 1,326 bullets) · VR Pedagogy (1,277 prose assertions vs 233 structured). Plus **promote the 4,961 existing span-anchored sandbox claims out of `tmp/`** (24 sources, 93.0% carrying char spans, 14,811 concept-mentions already linking them to ontology nodes with `provenance{bekker, chunk_id, char_start, char_end}`). *(This is the single largest available jump toward the goal and requires re-authoring nothing.)*

### C. Schema and IDs

**C1.** **Ship machine-checkable schema files as artifacts of the plan**, referenced by path: `claim.schema.json`, `clause.schema.json`, `edge.schema.json`, `locus.schema.json`, `tension.schema.json`, `term.schema.json`. **No `*.schema.json` exists anywhere in the repo today.** *(49 schema-violation defects)*

**C2.** **One worked exemplar record per type**, schema-valid and reachable, shipped with the plan and handed to every agent. *(`TEMPLATE:212` points agents at a prose file as the quality bar)*

**C3.** **Forbid bare strings in any array.** *(87 bare-string concepts, 146 interlocutors, 56 tensions, 57 sections in one entry)*

**C4.** **Fix the case convention (snake_case) in the schema, not in prose.** *(54 `sampleN` vs 41 `sample_n` inside the one field set the plan did specify — in prose)*

**C5.** **Full id grammar at every level, with worked examples,** globally unique across the entire `corpus/index/` tree: `<ENTRY>-<UNIT>-C<nnnn>` claims, `-CL<nnnnn>` clauses, `-S<nnn>` sections, `-T<nnn>` tensions, `-Q<nnn>` quotes, `-E<nnn>` edges. **Explicitly forbid unprefixed local counters.** *(42 colliding values across 8 units; `DA1`–`DA3` collide 8 ways)*

**C6.** **IDs are content-addressed, not positional:** `entry_id + unit_id + sha256(claim_text)[0:8]`. Positional ids renumber on every insert. *(44 dangling-reference + 10 id-collision defects)*

**C7.** **Ids are the ONLY join key.** Ban name-based merging; a same-name concept across entries becomes an explicit authored `sameAs` edge. *(the compiler merges on `name.lower()`, producing 20 fused rows with concatenated provenance; no compiled node carries an id at all)*

**C8.** **Committed prefix and id registry** (prefix → entry → grammar → allocated ranges → status). Reserving the prefix is step 0. Collision fails the build. *(the `bor-` → `bex-` rename was unrecorded and `bor-` was subsequently taken by Boredom Secondary)*

**C9.** **Every categorical field gets a closed enum stated inline in the plan**, with null illegal on `stance`, `support_tier`, `provenance`, `claim_kind`, `evidence_type`. Free-text nuance goes to a separate `note`. **Enums must be pairwise disjoint** and the validator must reject cross-contamination. *(`stance: "FE"` 22 times; `FAITHFUL-Elpidorou, p.4` smuggling a locus into the tag field — which was, note, plan-compliant given `boredom:33`'s own template)*

**C10.** **Global versioned relation and type registry**, extensible only by a registered subtype declaring its parent, written back in the same commit. Gate: every relation string resolves. *(645 distinct relation values across 219 CSVs; edges from two entries cannot be unioned)*

**C11.** **One canonical edge record, one physical format** at per-source and aggregate level, header stated verbatim in the plan, gated on exact equality: `edge_id, entry_id, subject_id, relation, object_id, domain, locators[], provenance, support_tier, confidence, deriving_unit, note`. Typed endpoints — record ids, never display strings. *(four incompatible headers; 119 rows with `§4`/`n.8`/`Intro` as subject; and a canonical schema four months older already existed at `scripts/normalize-edges.py` and was never cited)*

**C12.** **One authoritative store per layer; every `.md` is GENERATED** by a committed script and gated on byte-reproducibility. Kill the hand-authored `{md,json}` twin pattern. *(`TEMPLATE:114, :176-177`; 36 canonical positions lost to JSON files the compiler never opens; Uncomfortable's two disjoint concept registries)*

**C13.** **Stamp `schema_version` into every artifact.** *(only Dissertation does; nothing else can be migrated safely)*

**C14.** **`surface_form` is a first-class indexed field** alongside the normalized label. *(`TEMPLATE:81-88` normalises the source's own term into a free-text note)*

**C15.** **UTF-8 NFC normalisation rule + one canonical orthography per lemma with `variants[]`;** a checker flags any two lemmas differing only by normalisation or mojibake. **Forbid encoding fallbacks in the loader** — a decode failure is a hard error, not silent latin-1. *(Uexküll's four orthographies; the corrupted one wins)*

### D. Provenance and verification

**D1.** **`provenance` is a required enum field on every record**, not a prose convention. *(currently 201 of 463 Boredom readings carry null; VR Pedagogy has 1,136 prose tokens vs 233 fields)*

**D2.** **`derivation` on every record** (`agent-read / self-authored / inferred / script-derived`), with a gate on the self-authored fraction. **Forbid the orchestrator from self-authoring a unit it has not read**; re-dispatch to a fresh agent with the source. *(`TEMPLATE:208-210`)*

**D3.** **Quotation is machine-verified, not length-limited.** Every quoted span at any length is stored as `{quote_id, doc_id, char_start, char_end, exact_text, sha256}` extracted from the committed text layer, never typed by an agent. **Ban quotation marks in hand-typed prose**; quotations are interpolated by id (`scripts/substitute-quote-ids.py` already exists and exits 1 on unknown ids — wire it). Gate: re-slice the committed text at the recorded offsets and assert byte equality. *(≥4 fabricated spans shipped in `ped-sec-29` under FE tags, all inside the 12-word allowance)*

**D4.** **Rights-tiered storage/display split.** Store the exact span for every tier; the word ceiling applies only to **rendered output** and only for restricted tiers, with `redact_on_render` on the record. **Forbid the FE tag on any sentence containing an unverified quoted span.** *(`TEMPLATE:44`; the current rule forced In-Game to truncate canonical definitions to 24/23/20 words and Uncomfortable to suppress the clause entirely)*

**D5.** **Persist retrieval provenance, never assert it.** Every quotation record carries `{doc_id, chunk_id, page, bbox[x0,y0,x1,y1], char_span, sim, mode, snapshot_id, run_timestamp}` exactly as `archon evidence find --mode exact` returns them. **Ban the token `bbox ✓` as evidence.** Gate: numeric-bbox coverage = 100%. *(45+ ticks recorded across three entries; zero coordinates stored — the clause-level address existed at authoring time in every one of those 22 loci and was thrown away)*

**D6.** **Locator resolvability gate:** ≥3 randomly sampled loci per source verified by string-matching the cited text on the mapped page; every char span resolves inside the committed text; every recorded page resolves inside the document's real range. *(loci are currently "carried", never resolved)*

**D7.** **Bibliographic verification against the title page / DOI / copyright line**, recording the version-of-record year, gated `verified_bibliography: true`. **Decouple storage handles from bibliographic facts** — folders and filenames use the opaque id alone. **Gate that no unresolved corrections file exists at sign-off.** *(the `Colin`/Barrett freeze is permanent; `citation-corrections-2026-07-16.md` documents four corrections still unapplied)*

**D8.** **Record per-unit build provenance** in the manifest: agent id, model, retries, self-authored flag, cost. **Independent second-reader verification on a stated sample fraction with a stated pass threshold.** *(no build provenance is recorded anywhere)*

### E. Edges and connection

**E1.** **Invert the edge default.** Every relation an author can state in prose MUST be emitted as a typed edge; omission requires a recorded rationale. *(cross-entry references currently live in prose and reach nothing)*

**E2.** **Referential integrity is a hard gate.** Every `subject_id`/`object_id` resolves to an existing record in this entry or a registered sibling. Unresolvable = 0, or a typed row in the open-items file with a named blocking dependency. **Forbid authoring any edge whose target entry does not exist**; route intent to `pending-bridges.json`. *(`grounds-measure` 0/37; `bridges-to-part-iii` 0/128; `vr-ped:20,:132` explicitly authorised 24 edges to a never-built anchor)*

**E3.** **Enumerate the literal target id list inline for every cross-entry relation,** or ship the command that generates it; where the target does not yet exist, use reserved placeholder ids from a declared namespace, never free text. *(`boredom:24` → 100% resolution; prose description → 0%)*

**E4.** **Evidence-preserving merge, implemented as a committed script.** Merge on `(subject_id, relation, object_id)` and **UNION the locator sets**; emit `{rows_in, rows_out, loci_in, loci_preserved, dropped_ids[], drop_reason_histogram}`; **fail when `loci_preserved < loci_in`** or when any `drop_reason` is `unknown`. Better still: never dedup on content at all — concatenate on `edge_id` and report near-duplicates for human resolution. **Gate `count(global) == sum(count(per-unit))` as exact equality.** *(18 + 2 evidence rows destroyed; the count-mismatch class is 66 of 551)*

**E5.** **Bridges require two resolved endpoints or they do not exist:** `{bridge_id, source_entry_id, source_node_id, target_entry_id, target_node_id, bridge_text (min length), evidence_locus_source, evidence_locus_target, state}`. Empty endpoint = hard failure. *(42 of 72 live hooks have an empty `targetConcept`; `cross-author-utils.ts:473-474` makes `t.includes('')` always true, so all 42 are candidates for every topic; 525 of 552 sandbox bridge candidates were generated against an empty anchor and 85% came back "unrelated", versus 25 of 27 usable from well-formed anchors — a 6× yield difference)*

**E6.** **Floor source-derived records; CAP interpretive ones.** `P`-tagged ≤ 0.15 × (`FE` + `FAITHFUL`). *(`vr-ped:184,:220` mandate a *minimum* of the project's own speculation per unit; 117 speculative edges = 10.4% of the store)*

**E7.** **Separate data caps from render caps, explicitly.** No cap on cross-entry edges, canonical nodes, concordance cells or claim records in the store; caps apply only to a generated view, produced by filtering on tier/centrality. *(`TEMPLATE:185`'s ≤25 cap forced strand-level aggregation that deleted 117 unit-level edges into 8 integer labels)*

**E8.** **Every matrix/concordance/graph is a GENERATED VIEW over records**, never hand- or join-built. Every cell-source assertion resolves to exactly one `claim_id` and carries direction, effect size (or null), and provenance. **Explicitly forbid mechanical co-occurrence derivation by name** — it is the cheapest way to pass a coverage gate. Gate: `unbacked_assertions == 0`. *(85–91% of VR Pedagogy's concordance assertions are co-occurrence artifacts)*

**E9.** **Build a reverse-reference index at compile time** (record id → every file citing it) and make correction transactional: changing a record lists dependents and fails until each is updated or waived. *(a superseded VLE figure has 12 live copies in a sibling entry; 22 live "not yet built" assertions about an entry built 2026-07-16)*

### F. Weakness and tension encoding

**F1.** **`support_tier` is required on every claim**, using the 8-tier taxonomy. This is the mechanism by which "every weakness" becomes queryable: T4/T5/T6/T7 are the weaknesses, machine-selectable. *(Dissertation: 477 T3, 41 T4, 71 T5, 12 T6, 22 T7 over 982 records — the only working instance in the corpus)*

**F2.** **Pair `flag_present` with the quoted hedge** (`flag_text`). *(this is what makes a T3 rating auditable rather than asserted)*

**F3.** **Tensions get a typed record and the compiler's exact key names.** One shape subsuming all eight observed on disk: `{tension_id, entry_id, endpoint_a{node_id,label}, endpoint_b{node_id,label}, relation, directed, evidence_locus_a, evidence_locus_b, description, unit_ids[], claim_ids[], staged_by_sources: bool}`. Must cover `node_a/node_b`, `nodeA/nodeB/type`, `wendt_position/against`, `pole_A/pole_B`, `tension_id/label/supporting_units`, `pentad_terms_involved`, and the FCM `locus_a/locus_b` variant. *(55 records lost; 4 of 11 files yield zero)*

**F4.** **Contested readings are typed records at ENTRY scope, re-based on named external interlocutors**, not a prose list and not a cross-source-only artifact. *(VR CR-01/CR-03 contest Short et al. 1976 and the SSQ — neither a cluster unit; 18 shipped against a stated band of 8–12, unflagged, because the artifact has no format)*

**F5.** **Replace count targets on relational discoveries with coverage + evidence gates.** Every recorded disagreement cites ≥2 distinct records with resolvable loci on opposing sides and carries `staged_by_sources`; report analyst-constructed axes separately and never gate on the total. *(VR DA-07 and DA-08 reference exactly one unit each; Boredom flags 3 of 11 axes `constructedByCluster`)*

**F6.** **`implicit_citations_needed[]` is a required array** — the index must name the citation the prose is *missing*, not only what it has. *(Dissertation 982/982; nothing else in the corpus does this)*

**F7.** **`volatility` + `disposition` on every claim.** *(VDS: a vocabulary change becomes a work queue instead of silent rot; the only actionable-during-drafting fields in the corpus)*

### G. Gates

**G1.** **Every gate is a named committed executable with a numeric threshold and an exit code.** Required checkers, all of which must exist **before** authoring begins: `check-schema`, `check-ids` (uniqueness + cross-ref resolution), `check-loci` (resolution through the declared offset map), `check-projection` (re-run extraction, compare sha256), `check-density`, `check-coverage`, `check-registration` (non-zero compiled contribution per layer), `check-quotes` (span fidelity + rights class), `check-lemmas` (non-Latin assertion on lemma fields + NFC), `check-mermaid` (`mmdc`, non-zero exit if absent), `check-debates`, `check-dedup` (loci preserved), `emit-gates`. **A gate whose executable is missing must FAIL, not pass by narration.** *(`TEMPLATE:199,:228` name a verbatim detector that does not exist)*

**G2.** **Never name a tool the plan does not ship.** *(same)*

**G3.** **Gate results are artifacts:** `_audit/gates.json` — one object per gate `{gate_id, scope, threshold_expr, threshold_value, measured, verdict (PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED-N1/NA-BY-CONSTRUCTION), checker, checker_version, measured_at, input_sha256, evidence_path}` — plus `_audit/metrics.json` and a rendered report. Registration is conditional on zero FAILs. **Preserve RDR2's "Gates NOT fully met (reported honestly)" as a required section.** *(2 of 27 entries have a report; 1 has metrics)*

**G4.** **Never write a derived constant into a gate.** Every threshold is an expression over a value the checker reads from the manifest at check time. **Delete "do not re-open" phrasing** from any decision a later phase can invalidate, and add an explicit scope-change procedure: any change to N re-runs the gate script and requires fresh sign-off. *(`vr-ped:213,:216` froze N=23 and 276 while N drifted to 34)*

**G5.** **Separate producer from judge structurally.** Authoring agents may not write gate results. *(every surviving gate record in the corpus is self-attestation embedded inside the artifact it judges)*

**G6.** **Replace "compiler runs clean" with validate-then-load that exits non-zero.** Assertions: manifest-declared count per record type == loaded count; zero-yield for a registered source is a hard failure; every rejected record is written to a rejects file with a reason; gate on the rejects file being empty and on `compiler_warnings == 0`. *(`main()` cannot fail; 55 records discarded with 0 warnings)*

**G7.** **Never gate on a marker; gate on the loader's output.** Run the loader, read back the count, and round-trip a named spot-check record field-for-field. *(the `## 3A` gate is uncorrelated with what the parser does; the count gate certified 60 nodes while 19 were corrupted)*

**G8.** **Registration contract test as a Phase-0 gate.** Compile a committed fixture, assert the compiled output exactly equals an expected node list; re-run on the real entry asserting (a) compiled count == authored count, (b) every compiled name string-equals its authored heading, (c) `greek`/`transliteration` empty for non-classical entries, (d) `canonicalTerms` contributed by this entry minus authored names == ∅. *(19 corrupted nodes; `technological` and `control` in the global greedy-match list)*

**G9.** **Canonical-term admission gate.** A term enters the global list only if declared in a per-entry terms file, exceeds a minimum length, and is not a bare common English word (stoplist). Print the full diff of terms this entry adds, for sign-off at G1. *(1,722 terms currently including whole sentences and bare words)*

**G10.** **Every gate is scope-tagged RECORD / ENTRY / GROUP with a declared minimum N,** and the checker emits `NA-BY-CONSTRUCTION` rather than a missing artifact below the minimum. **N=1 is the default path.** Per-source intrinsic gates, all meaningful at N=1: records per 1,000 source words · schema-validity rate = 1.0 · id-uniqueness = 1.0 · enum-conformance = 1.0 · locator-resolution rate = 1.0 · quote-verification rate = 1.0 · char-span coverage ≥ 0.90 (the sandbox already achieves 0.930) with a `match_ratio` floor (its minimum is 0.083 against a median of 1.000) · section coverage = 1.0 · endpoint-resolution rate = 1.0 · unbacked assertions = 0 · reachability ≥ 0.95 · unresolved `******` = 0 · self-authored fraction ≤ threshold. Move debates, intra-cluster citation network and the scholarly-evolution arc to a GROUP layer with minimum membership ≥5. **Skipping a GROUP gate is a pass.** *(3 gates genuinely collapse; 1 is unsatisfiable by construction; `max(10, N/4)` taught executors to reinterpret rather than fail)*

**G11.** **Reachability gate:** `reachable_records / authored_records ≥ 0.95`, computed by a script that loads the compiled artifact and resolves authored ids, plus a per-artifact table `records_on_disk vs records_in_compiled_index`. **No artifact ships at 0% reachability** without a signed waiver naming the future loader. *(VR Pedagogy scores 0.046)*

**G12.** **File-manifest gate.** Ship `manifest.expected.json` as data; gate on set equality with the on-disk tree, both directions. *(`units/` empty in both template-lineage entries; four artifacts specified-but-absent in Boredom)*

**G13.** **Cross-artifact numeric consistency gate.** Scan every `.md`/`.json` in the entry for count claims and fail on any that disagrees with the one authoritative register. Mark superseded phase artifacts SUPERSEDED with a pointer. *(`phase0-overview.md` permanently declares 46 against a manifest of 55; BCAP §3B contradicts its companion CSV in every line)*

**G14.** **Post-build corpus-wide invariant sweep** after any entry is created or renamed: grep the whole index for assertions about its prior state (`not yet built`, `****** UNVERIFIED`, superseded prefixes, superseded counts) and fail on any hit. *(22 live hits for the Boredom anchor; 12 for the superseded VLE figure)*

**G15.** **Duplicate-content gate:** normalised shingle overlap between any two unit files above threshold fails the build, replacing prose "no duplication" rules. *(three files assert non-duplication that a fourth falsifies inside one entry)*

**G16.** **"Gates deferred" is prohibited.** A build with deferred gates is a draft and must not register. *(VLE's manifest records `"gates deferred to post-run review"`; the review never happened and 100% of what VLE serves to runtime is stale)*

**G17.** **Preserve backups + G0 + G1 + no-commit-before-G1**, with the backup paths named and their existence and timestamp ordering asserted by the gate script. **G1 reviews `gates.json`, the per-layer compiled-contribution delta, a checker-selected random sample of k records with their loci actually opened and resolved, the canonical-term diff, and the open-items list** — not one author-chosen unit trio (1.8% of a 55-unit build). *(`TEMPLATE:229`; Boredom's `.backups/` contains neither file the plan names)*
